stem: According to the article, why did Washington want his own information-gathering agency?

options.label: F
options.text: He trusted only friends to bring him accurate information.

options.label: G
options.text: He was fascinated with the idea of spies and invisible ink.

options.label: H
options.text: He thought the British were spying on his Continental forces.
